data.long_meaning: Atiksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ati' meaning 'beyond' and 'ksh' meaning 'knowledge'. This name signifies having wisdom before taking action. It is a name for a boy who is wise and thoughtful. The name Atiksh carries the meaning “Wisdom Before Action” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atiksh usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom before action and live with faith, good character and purpose.
